chunks: Que Dieu fasse miséricorde à celui qui a embrassé la repentance, a renoncé aux péchés et s'est hâté (d'accomplir de bonnes actions avant) sa mort.
ai.seo_question: Quelles sont les trois actions clés qu'un croyant doit accomplir pour obtenir la miséricorde divine selon Nahj al-Balagha ?
ai.summary: Attributed to Imam Ali in the context of rain supplications, this maxim links spiritual readiness with physical sustenance, reflecting the Shia tradition of viewing repentance as a catalyst for divine mercy. It underscores the urgency of 'hastening to death' (bādira manīyatahu) not as seeking demise, but as accelerating the accumulation of good deeds before the inevitable end.
